observed.caption: Wide elevated view of an urban park with a pond and scattered trees in the foreground and a dense city skyline under a partly cloudy blue sky in the background.
observed.description: The photo shows an outdoor urban park in the foreground with patches of green and brown grass, scattered trees with green foliage, and a small white signboard standing in the grass. A paved road and an open reddish-brown dirt area lie beyond the grass, with several low covered pavilions with light-colored roofs lined up in front of a narrow pond or lake. Behind the pond are more trees and open parkland. In the distance a dense cluster of high-rise buildings of varying heights, colors and shapes forms a city skyline, including a distinctive cylindrical tower on the right and tall brown and beige towers on the left. A white car is visible on a road on the left side. Several small human figures are scattered across the grass and near the road, some sitting under trees and some standing or walking. The sky above is bright blue with scattered white cumulus clouds, indicating daytime with bright natural daylight.
